# Introduction

This document includes the differential gene expression analysis (DEA) for the gene, transcript and exon expression of the postmortem human brain (dorsolateral prefrontal cortex - Brodmann area 9) samples coming from patients with schizophrenia (SCZ), bipolar disorder (BPD) and major depression disorder (MDD) as well as healthy controls (CTL). We decided to combine all diagnosis (SCZ, BPD and MDD) to one case (CASE) for power reasons. We did not find any differentially expressed genes, transcripts or exons using the diagnosis as single cases. Following steps are performed for each level (gene, transcript and exon):

1. Load data
2. DEA for diagnosis correcting for all covariates
3. DEA using the polygenic risk score instead of the diagnosis (also correcting for covariates)

Below you can find the list of packages that are required by the workflow. 

```{r, echo = F}
# General Bioconductor packages
library(biomaRt)

# Data analysis
library(oligo)
library(limma)  # for differential expression

# Formatting packages
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Color palettes
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)

# Packages for plotting 
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(corrplot)
library(grid)
library(ggrepel)  # for volcanoplot
```

# Functions

As we have to do several analysis multiple times, we will put these into functions to reduce the lines of code. 

```{r definition, echo=F}
# function to run the linear model (limma) using the normal model for genes only 
RunLimma <- function(design, summary){
  # get top DE genes
  fit <- lmFit(summary, design)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
  return(fit2)
}

# functions to generate result tables
# 1. get top hits
# 2. rename columns
# 3. separate merged gene symbols and remove duplicated rows: necessary as exactly the same gene symbols (and IDs for transcript/exon level) were merged together. This happens because:
# on gene level: one of the transripts of the gene is an uncharacterized protein and therefore leads to two different gene ensembl IDs
# on transcript/exon level: two or more transcripts/exons have the exact same expression values and were merged together as also done for their gene symbols and IDs. Usually these gene symbols and IDs are just duplicates and we need to remove these for further analysis (e.g. new FDR correction). The merged transcript/exon IDs we will leave merged.
# 4. save the resulting table into an output file
GenerateResultTableGene <- function(fit, variable, file){
  top.hits <- topTable(fit, coef = variable, adjust = "BH", number = Inf)
  print(head(top.hits))
  print(paste0("log2FC range: ", round(min(top.hits$logFC), 2), " until ", round(max(top.hits$logFC), 2)))
  colnames(top.hits) <- c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Location", "Gene Symbol", "logFC", "Average Expression", "t-statistic", "p-value", "FDR estimate", "B coefficient")
  top.hits <- unique(separate_rows(top.hits, `Gene Symbol`, sep = "\\|"))
  write.table(top.hits, file = paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/results/", file), sep = "\t", row.names = F)
}
GenerateResultTableTranscript <- function(fit, variable, file){
  top.hits <- topTable(fit, coef = variable, adjust = "BH", number = Inf)
  print(head(top.hits))
  print(paste0("log2FC range: ", round(min(top.hits$logFC), 2), " until ", round(max(top.hits$logFC), 2)))
  colnames(top.hits) <- c("Ensembl Transcript ID", "Location", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "logFC", "Average Expression", "t-statistic", "p-value", "FDR estimate", "B coefficient")
  top.hits <- unique(separate_rows(top.hits, `Ensembl Gene ID`, sep = "\\|"))
  top.hits <- unique(separate_rows(top.hits, `Gene Symbol`, sep = "\\|"))
  write.table(top.hits, file = paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/results/", file), sep = "\t", row.names = F)
  return(top.hits)
}
GenerateResultTableExon <- function(fit, variable, file){
  top.hits <- topTable(fit, coef = variable, adjust = "BH", number = Inf)
  print(head(top.hits))
  print(paste0("log2FC range: ", round(min(top.hits$logFC), 2), " until ", round(max(top.hits$logFC), 2)))
  colnames(top.hits) <- c("Ensembl Exon ID", "Location", "Ensembl Transcript ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "logFC", "Average Expression", "t-statistic", "p-value", "FDR estimate", "B coefficient")
  top.hits <- unique(separate_rows(top.hits, `Ensembl Gene ID`, sep = "\\|"))
  top.hits <- unique(separate_rows(top.hits, `Gene Symbol`, sep = "\\|"))
  write.table(top.hits, file = paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/results/", file), sep = "\t", row.names = F)
  return(top.hits)
}

# function to generate a vulcano plot for differentially expressed genes
GenerateVolcanoPlot <- function(fit, variable, file) {
  # get all hits
  hits <- topTable(fit, coef = variable, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  total <- nrow(hits)
  # get first hit after FDR 10% for drawing a p-value threshold line
  index <- if(length(which(hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1)) == 0) 0 else which(hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1)
  threshold <- hits[index[length(index)] + 1, "P.Value"]
  ### volcano plot ###
  # label only significant hits (if more than 10)
  if(length(index) >= 10){
    ggplot(hits, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) + 
    theme_bw(base_size = 22) + 
    geom_point() + 
    xlim(-2, 2) + 
    ylim(0, 6) +
    xlab(bquote(~Log[2]~ "fold change")) +
    ylab(bquote(~-Log[10]~ italic(P))) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank()) +
    labs(caption = paste0("Total variables: ", total)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(threshold), linetype = "dashed") + 
        geom_point(data = hits[index, ], aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)), colour = viridis(1), size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[index[1:10], ], aes(label = gene_name), colour = viridis(1))
  # else: label hit genes (if some are found) purple and following genes green until a maximum of 10 genes is labeled
  } else if(length(index) == 1) {
    ggplot(hits, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) + 
    theme_bw(base_size = 22) + 
    geom_point() + 
    xlim(-2, 2) + 
    ylim(0, 6) +
    xlab(bquote(~Log[2]~ "fold change")) +
    ylab(bquote(~-Log[10]~ italic(P))) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank()) +
    labs(caption = paste0("Total variables: ", total)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(threshold), linetype = "dashed") + 
    geom_point(data = hits[1:10, ], aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)), colour = viridis(3)[2], size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[1:10, ], aes(label = gene_name), colour = viridis(3)[2])
  }  else {
    ggplot(hits, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) + 
    theme_bw(base_size = 22) + 
    geom_point() + 
    xlim(-2, 2) + 
    ylim(0, 6) +
    xlab(bquote(~Log[2]~ "fold change")) +
    ylab(bquote(~-Log[10]~ italic(P))) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank()) +
    labs(caption = paste0("Total variables: ", total)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(threshold), linetype = "dashed") + 
    geom_point(data = hits[index, ], aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)), colour = viridis(1), size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[index, ], aes(label = gene_name), colour = viridis(1)) +
    geom_point(data = hits[(length(index) + 1):10, ], aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)), colour = viridis(3)[2], size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[(length(index) + 1):10, ], aes(label = gene_name), colour = viridis(3)[2])
  }
  ggsave(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/figures/", file), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
}

# function to plot all differentially expressed hits for the different covariates corrected for all other covariates as a vertical barplot
GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits <- function(design, fit, from, to, adj, plot.name){
  # Get padj values for all different covariates
  nc <- ncol(design) - 1
  limma.res.fc <- topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf)
  limma.res.padj <- limma.res.fc[, from:(to + nc)]
  for (i in 1:nc){
    limma.res.padj[, i] = topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, adj]
    if(i == nc){
      limma.res.padj$`Gene Symbol` = topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, adj - 5]
      limma.res.padj$`Ensembl Gene ID` = topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, adj - 6]
    }
  }
  #head(limma.res.padj)
  limma.res.padj <- limma.res.padj[, -c(length(limma.res.padj) - 2)]  # remove SV1
  colnames(limma.res.padj) <- c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death1", "Type_of_Death2", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID")
  limma.res.padj$Type_of_Death <- (limma.res.padj$Type_of_Death1 + limma.res.padj$Type_of_Death2) / 2
  limma.res.padj <- limma.res.padj[, c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID")]
  # unmerge gene symbols and IDs and get only unique gene symbols/IDs as hits
  limma.res.padj <- unique(separate_rows(limma.res.padj, `Ensembl Gene ID`, sep = "\\|"))
  limma.res.padj <- unique(separate_rows(limma.res.padj, `Gene Symbol`, sep = "\\|"))
  # remove Gene symbols and IDs as we do not need them anymore (just for same results as in result tables)
  limma.res.padj$`Gene Symbol` <- NULL
  limma.res.padj$`Ensembl Gene ID` <- NULL
  # check, how many padj values are < 0.10
  limma.res.padj.0.05 <- apply(limma.res.padj, 2, function(x) sum(x < 0.1))
  limma.res.plot <- data.frame(sort(limma.res.padj.0.05, decreasing = T))
  # vertical barplot with ggplot2
  ggplot(limma.res.plot, aes(y = limma.res.plot$sort.limma.res.padj.0.05..decreasing...T., x = reorder(row.names(limma.res.plot), sort.limma.res.padj.0.05..decreasing...T.))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 22)) +
    ylab("# significant hits") +
    xlab("") +
    geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = limma.res.plot$sort.limma.res.padj.0.05..decreasing...T.), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
  ggsave(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/figures/", plot.name))
  return(limma.res.plot)
}

# function to recalculate the p-value and fdr for transcripts and exons based on gene level: load the result table, get the smallest p-value for a gene, calculate new fdr using the genes smallest p-values and gene number as background
GetExprWithSmallestP <- function(input, summaries){
  res <- fread(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/results/", input), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
  # get the rows with the lowest p-value per gene ID
  min.pval <- res[ , .SD[which.min(`p-value`)], by = `Ensembl Gene ID`]
  # get all transcript IDs with lowest p-value per gene ID
  index <- which(rownames(exprs(summaries)) %in% as.character(c(min.pval[, 2])[[1]]))
  # reduce transcriptSummaries to these transcripts
  summaries <- summaries[c(index), ]
  dim(summaries)
  return(summaries)
}
```


# Load data

## Microarray expression

Now, we will load the normalized and batch corrected microarray data summarized to gene, transcript and exon level. 

```{r, echo = F}
# Import RMA corrected and annotated Affymetrix microarray data on gene level (from core transcripts)
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/RData_Files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_core_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_gene_summaries_annotated.RData")
geneSummaries.core <- geneSummaries
exprs(geneSummaries.core) <- as.matrix(exprs(geneSummaries.core))
dim(geneSummaries.core)

# Import RMA corrected and annotated Affymetrix microarray data on gene level (from probesets)
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/RData_Files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_gene_summaries_annotated.RData")
exprs(geneSummaries) <- as.matrix(exprs(geneSummaries))
dim(geneSummaries)

# Import RMA corrected and annotated Affymetrix microarray data on transcript level
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/RData_Files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_transcript_summaries_annotated.RData")
exprs(transcriptSummaries) <- as.matrix(exprs(transcriptSummaries))
dim(transcriptSummaries)

# Import RMA corrected and annotated Affymetrix microarray data on exon level
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/RData_Files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_exon_summaries_annotated.RData")
exprs(exonSummaries) <- as.matrix(exprs(exonSummaries))
dim(exonSummaries)

# save pData into an extra variable (use pData of probeset genes as it includes SV1)
pData <- pData(geneSummaries)
```

## Polygenic risk scores

Then, we load the four different polygenic risk scores generated on the latest schizophrenia (SCZ), bipolar disorder (BIP), major depression disorder (MDD) and cross-disorder (CD) GWAS summary statistic files. 

```{r, echo = F}
# load SCZ2 PRS
prs.scz2 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/SCZ2/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_scz2_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))

# load MDD2 PRS
prs.mdd2 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/MDD2/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_mdd2_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))

# load BIP-2018 PRS
prs.bip <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/BIP-2018/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_bip_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))

# load Cross-disorder PRS
prs.cross.disorder <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/Cross_Disorder/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_cd_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))
```

All loaded PRS are added to the phenotype (pData) information.

```{r, echo = F}
pData$PRS.SCZ <- unlist(prs.scz2[prs.scz2$IID %in% pData$IID, "PRS"])
pData$PRS.MDD <- unlist(prs.mdd2[prs.mdd2$IID %in% pData$IID, "PRS"])
pData$PRS.BIP <- unlist(prs.bip[prs.bip$IID %in% pData$IID, "PRS"])
pData$PRS.CD <- unlist(prs.cross.disorder[prs.cross.disorder$IID %in% pData$IID, "PRS"])
rm(prs.bip, prs.mdd2, prs.scz2, prs.cross.disorder)
```


# Differential Gene Expression Analysis

Now, we calculate the differentially expressed genes, transcripts and exons using a linear mixed model (limma package) correcting for all the covariates. We will also generate output tables and vulcano plots for all results.

## Gene level

### Diagnosis with normal model

First, run the linear model with correction for all covariates and generate the result table. 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)

# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, geneSummaries)

# result table
GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.csv")

# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.1_volcano_plot_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.pdf")
```

Get significantly differentially expressed genes for all the different covariates (corrected for all the other covariates). 

```{r, echo = F}
# generate vertical barplot
limma.res.gene <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 4, to = 3, adj = 8, plot.name = "1.1_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_genes.pdf")
rm(design, fit)
```

### Diagnosis with sex and diagnosis interaction model

Adding (Dx*Sex) to the model.

```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1 + (Sex * Dx), pData)

# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, geneSummaries)

# result table
GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.2_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.csv")

# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.2_volcano_plot_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.pdf")
```

Plot residuals of Sex vs. Diagnosis for the one hit gene (TRIM10):

```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design.res <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)
# fit model
fit.res <- lmFit(geneSummaries, design.res)
# get residuals
res <- residuals.MArrayLM(fit.res, exprs(geneSummaries))

# generate boxplot with case vs control for male and female samples of the hit gene (TRIM10)
trim10 <- res[rownames(res) == "ENSG00000204613.6", ]
trim10 <- t(t(as.data.frame(trim10)))
trim10 <- merge(trim10, pData[, c("ShortName", "Dx", "Sex")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName", all.x = T)
trim10$DxSex <- paste0(trim10$Dx, trim10$Sex)

pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/figures/1.2_boxplot_TRIM10_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
ggplot(trim10, aes(Sex, trim10, fill = Dx)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Female", "Male")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(3), labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) + 
  ggtitle("TRIM10") +
  ylab("Gene expression") + 
  xlab("Sex") + 
  labs(fill = "Diagnosis")
dev.off()
# p-value females
females <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "F",]
case <- females[females$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- females[females$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.01022
# p-value males
males <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "M",]
case <- males[males$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- males[males$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.05302

# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit, design.res, fit.res, res, trim10, females, males, case, control)
```

### PRS with normal model

Now, we use the polygenic risk scores based on the SCZ, BPD, MDD and Cross-disorder GWAS instead of the diagnosis as input.

**SCZ PRS**

```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ PRS.SCZ + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)

# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, geneSummaries)

# result table
GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "PRS.SCZ", file =  "2.1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_SCZ_PRS.csv")

# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "PRS.SCZ", file = "2.1.1_volcano_plot_diff_expr_genes_for_SCZ_PRS.pdf")
rm(design, fit)
```

**Cross-disorder PRS**

```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ PRS.CD + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)

# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, geneSummaries)

# result table
GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "PRS.CD", file =  "2.1.4_diff_expr_genes_for_CD_PRS.csv")

```


## Transcript level

### Diagnosis with normal model

First, run the linear model with correction for all covariates and generate the result table. 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)

# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, transcriptSummaries)

# result table
top.hits <- GenerateResultTableTranscript(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis.csv")

# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.1_volcano_plot_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis.pdf")
```

No hits. Maybe a problem of the multiple testing correction as we have too many transcripts to correct for. We will test a new FDR correction model in one of the following sections.

Get significantly differentially expressed transcripts for all the different covariates (corrected for all the other covariates). 

```{r, echo = F}
# generate vertical barplot
limma.res.transcript <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 5, to = 4, adj = 9, plot.name = "1.1_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts.pdf")
rm(design, fit, top.hits)
```

### Diagnosis with recalculated p-values and FDR

As the low adjusted p-values of the transcript expressions could come from the high number of transcripts to test for, we want to redo the adjusted p-value calculation as followed:

1. Take the lowest p-value of all transcripts corresponding to a gene
2. Get all transcript IDs and reduce the expression Set to these transcripts
2. Calculate p-values and FDR using limma on the reduced transcript set

```{r, echo = F}
# reduce expression set
dim(transcriptSummaries)
transcriptSummaries.new <- GetExprWithSmallestP(input = "1.1_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis.csv", transcriptSummaries)
dim(transcriptSummaries.new)

# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)

# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, transcriptSummaries.new)

# result table
top.hits <- GenerateResultTableTranscript(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")

# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.3_volcano_plot_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")
```

Now, we have multiple hits on the transcript level. We could find transcripts on following genes as significant:

1. with FDR < 5%: `r length(top.hits[top.hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.05, "Gene Symbol"])` 

2. with FDR < 10%: `r length(top.hits[top.hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Gene Symbol"])`

Four genes with an FDR < 0.05:  `r top.hits[top.hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.05, "Gene Symbol"]`

Six genes with an FDR < 0.1:  `r top.hits[top.hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Gene Symbol"]`

Get significantly differentially expressed transcripts for all the different covariates (corrected for all the other covariates). 

```{r, echo = F}
# generate vertical barplot
limma.res.transcript.new <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 5, to = 4, adj = 9, plot.name = "1.3_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")
rm(design, fit, top.hits)
```

## Exon level 

### Diagnosis with normal model

First, run the linear model with correction for all covariates and generate the result table. 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)

# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, exonSummaries)

# result table
top.hits <- GenerateResultTableExon(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis.csv")

# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.1_volcano_plot_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis.pdf")
```

Get significantly differentially expressed genes for all the different covariates. 

```{r, echo = F}
# generate vertical barplot
limma.res.exon <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 6, to = 5, adj = 10, plot.name = "1.1_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_exons.pdf")
```

Now, we combine the barplot of the number of differentially expressed genes, transcripts and exons per covariate (corrected for all other covariates). 

```{r, echo = F}
### ALL COMBINED (gene + transcript + exon barplot) ###
colnames(limma.res.gene) <- "counts"
limma.res.gene$type <- "gene"
limma.res.gene$covariates <- row.names(limma.res.gene)
colnames(limma.res.transcript) <- "counts"
limma.res.transcript$type <- "transcript"
limma.res.transcript$covariates <- row.names(limma.res.transcript)
colnames(limma.res.exon) <- "counts"
limma.res.exon$type <- "exon"
limma.res.exon$covariates <- row.names(limma.res.exon)
limma.res.all <- rbind(limma.res.gene, limma.res.transcript, limma.res.exon)
limma.res.all$covariates <- as.factor(limma.res.all$covariates)
limma.res.all$covariates <- factor(limma.res.all$covariates, levels = c("C4", "C3", "C2", "C1", "Type_of_Death","Suicide", "Sex", "RIN2", "RIN", "Diagnosis", "PMI", "pH", "Age"))

# save plot
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/figures/1.1_barplots_significant_DEA_hits_gene_transcript_exon_combined.pdf")
p <- ggplot(limma.res.all, aes(y = counts, x = covariates)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(axis.ticks = element_line(colour = NA), text = element_text(size = 22), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), strip.background =element_rect(fill = NA)) +
  ylab("# significant hits") +
  xlab("") +
  geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = limma.res.all$counts), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
p + facet_wrap(~ type, scale = "free_x") + theme(panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"))
dev.off()
# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit, top.hits, limma.res.exon, limma.res.transcript, limma.res.all, p)
```

## eQTL hits

Check exon expression for exons found in the cases & control, case only and unique case only eQTL dataset for any differentially expressed exon hits. Therefore, we load all exon eQTL hits.

```{r}
# cases and controls
data <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/output/01_pmb_CASE_CTL_matrixEQTL_cis_results_exons.txt", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
cis.exons.all <- data[data$FDR < 0.05,   ]  # filter for only eQTLs with adjusted p-value (FDR) < 0.05
# case only
data <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/output/02_pmb_CASE_only_matrixEQTL_cis_results_exons.txt", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
cis.exons.cases <- data[data$FDR < 0.05,  ]  # filter for only eQTLs with adjusted p-value (FDR) < 0.05
# TODO: unique case only exon eQTLs
```

### Cases and control exon eQTL

First, we filter the exon expression for exons with an eQTL hit:

```{r}
exons <- unique(cis.exons.cases$gene)
index <- which(rownames(exprs(exonSummaries)) %in% as.character(exons))
dim(exonSummaries)
exonSummaries <- exonSummaries[c(index), ]
dim(exonSummaries)
```

Now, we can run the linear model with correction for all covariates and generate the result table. 

```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
pData <- pData(exonSummaries)
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)

# get top DE genes
fit <- lmFit(exonSummaries, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
top.hits <- topTable(fit2, coef = "DxCASE", adjust = "BH", number = Inf)
head(top.hits)
```
